preview.//: The profile to use. Produces an installable .apk rather than the .aab the Play Store wants — nothing here goes near a store, it goes straight onto your own phone. Bound to the 'preview' update channel, so `eas update --branch preview` reaches builds made with this profile.

production.//: Kept for the day this does go to a store. .aab, its own channel, so a production build never picks up an update meant for the phone in your pocket.

development.//: A dev client — the debug build you attach the Metro bundler to. Not needed for normal use; useful when a native module is misbehaving and Expo Go cannot load it.
